title: Cayley-graph density of Thompson's group F: local deletions and finite-window bounds
summary: Let $Γ$ be the Cayley graph of Thompson's group $F$ with its standard generators. Belk and Brown constructed finite marked-forest subgraphs of limiting density $7/2$, and Guba showed that deleting certain low-degree vertices gives density greater than $3.5004$. We refine this approach in two directions.
